authorization: User explicitly authorized two independent security publishers agreeing on the vulnerability class, with Codex reasoning documented
adjudication_basis: CertiK explains inflation of UZD balances through manipulated asset pricing. PeckShield independently diagnoses donation-based miscalculation of price. Both link the transaction to the same Zunami incident. The consensus class is oracle price manipulation; no generic flash-loan label or unrelated SWC code is substituted.

independent_observations.mechanism_excerpt: The attacker was able to inflate their UZD balance 3x by taking advantage of the way in which UDZ is calculated.
It is a price manipulation issue, which can be exploited by donation to incorrectly calculate the price
